message: Fixes live revocation end-to-end. The client now dynamically discovers the actual GEN2 license.dat used on the machine, including alternate AI Training product directories, extracts the hardware-bound License ID from raw or DPAPI-protected storage, and latches that exact ID for the full running session. The signed GitHub revocation list is checked every 5 seconds. The public revocation signature was repaired, and the rebuilt admin now signs Revoke/Restore/Delete atomically and verifies the exact published bytes before reporting success.
